title: How Much Do NASA Astronauts Get Paid?
description:
You go to space for NASA. But what's the paycheck?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: NASA Astronaut Corps (Salary section): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA_Astronaut_Corps
- Wikipedia: General Schedule (US civil service pay scale): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Schedule_(US_civil_service_pay_scale)

As of 2023, astronauts at Johnson Space Center in Houston earned between $79,766 (GS-11 step 1) and $183,500 (GS-15 step 6 and above). Since the 2024 candidate class, new candidates are paid on an Administratively Determined scale. 339 candidates selected to date, including the Original Seven. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: You go to space for NASA. But what's the paycheck?
Astronauts were paid on the regular government pay scale. Just like other federal jobs.
In 2023, starting pay in Houston was only about 80,000 dollars.
But only 339 people have ever been picked.
